events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Detroit weekend after the party size and arrival mode changed in the prior session.

Current constraints are keeping Saturday access to the Detroit Institute of Arts easy, avoiding unnecessary parking fees, making the Friday train arrival transfer simple, and confirming whether the room has a coffee maker and mini-fridge. The unresolved decision is whether to modify the Midtown reservation plan or switch to a more train-friendly downtown option before the refundable deadline.

events.continuity_hook: Performs a brief Pittsburgh pre-trip check after the hotel and flights were set.

events.continuity_hook: Starts the next summer professional-trip episode after completing the Pittsburgh site visit.
events.interaction_goal: Create a compact comparison of flight and hotel pairings with estimated total cost, arrival and return timing, meeting access, airport transfer options, breakfast, in-room basics, and nearby dinner choices.
events.scenario_brief: After the Pittsburgh visit wraps, Marisol begins planning a July 21-23 Philadelphia sector symposium with a Tuesday afternoon funder roundtable, Wednesday sessions at the conference hotel, and a Thursday closing panel expected to end around 11:45 a.m. with lunch likely afterward.
